name: phone-a-friend
description: CLI relay that lets AI coding agents collaborate by sending prompts and repository context to backend agents.

interface.longDescription: Get second opinions and code reviews from Antigravity, Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, pi or Ollama while working in Codex. The phone-a-team skill runs iterative Bash-orchestrated rounds and lets the host model synthesize the results. Requires a local coding host with shell access, Node.js 22.13+, a PATH-installed phone-a-friend CLI, and separately configured backends. Plugin installation supplies skills; it does not install or authenticate backend CLIs. Hosted chat without local shell access cannot run these workflows. Provider charges and local history apply; see the privacy notice.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude through phone-a-friend for a sanity review of this repo
Spin up reviewers across Claude and Gemini to debate this change
Iterate this implementation with phone-a-team across multiple backends
